turns.message: Our audit codename is Silver Birch. Which inputs do you need before planning this integration audit? Reply briefly.
turns.reply: What are the key objectives and scope of the Silver Birch audit?

turns.message: What was the audit codename I gave you? Reply with the codename.
What evidence would you request before accepting an integration audit? Reply briefly.
turns.reply: I would request documentation of the audit scope, methodology, findings, and signed conclusions from the third-party auditor, along with evidence of compliance with relevant standards (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO 27001) and any corrective actions taken.
